newsitem.title: USA: American Dental effects reverse split.
newsitem.headline: American Dental effects reverse split.

text.p: American Dental Technologies Inc said Monday that, effective today, it will effect a one-for-four reverse split of its common stock.

The reverse split was approved in December by American Dental's board. The company added that 98 percent of the shares voted and 84 percent of the total shares outstanding also approved the reverse split.

American Dental's authorized common stock was reduced in the reverse split to 12,500,000 shares from 50,000,000 previously. After the reverse split, a maximum of 6,947,689 shares will be issued and outstanding, down from 27,790,757 previously.

American Dental, which makes advanced technologies for dentistry, said the primary purpose of the reverse split was to reduce the number of authorized and outstanding shares to increase the trading price and stimulate broader interest in the stock.
The company said it will file a listing application for the Nasdaq National Market this week.
